investigationQuestions.question_text: Can the bank provide transaction-level authentication records showing the authentication method, device or wallet identifiers, token status, and timestamps for each disputed transaction, particularly after the new digital token registration?
Can the bank provide records of its fraud monitoring system logs, alerts generated, and incident response actions related to the five disputed transactions occurring within the 18-minute timeframe?

Can the bank provide call logs or recordings of the customer’s fraud hotline call at 09:21 on 23 October along with a detailed chronology and summary of investigation and containment measures taken subsequent to the report?

evidenceRequests.request_text: Please provide detailed transaction-level authentication records for each disputed transaction, including the authentication method used, device or wallet identifiers, token status, and timestamps, especially after the registration of the new digital token.

Please provide the bank's fraud monitoring system logs, records of any alerts generated, and documentation of incident response actions taken related to the five disputed transactions within the 18-minute period.

Please provide call logs or recordings of the customer's fraud hotline call made at 09:21 on 23 October, along with a detailed timeline and summary of the bank's investigation and containment actions taken following the call.

executive_summary.narrative: On 23 October 2024, a new digital token was registered on the customer's account shortly before five disputed transactions were processed within an 18-minute period. Upon discovering the transactions, the customer immediately contacted the DBS fraud hotline to report the suspected fraud. DBS subsequently declined the customer's dispute, relying on its position that the transactions were authenticated using 3D Secure, contactless and EMV payment mechanisms. The central issues in this dispute are whether the transactions were genuinely authorised, whether the transaction pattern should have triggered fraud detection or intervention, and whether the bank's response following the customer's notification was timely and appropriate.
